Packaging: Each package contains a bohemian curtain panel. The top rod bag matches the standard curtain rod, and the sewn rod bag is very easy to hang and slide.
Easy to clean: The curtains can be washed with a washing machine. Wash in low-temperature water with mild detergent. Iron if necessary. Dry in a well-ventilated place. Do not expose to the sun, twist or bleach.

Our small curtain panels used in different places can be used with blackout curtains to become the perfect window decoration, bringing an elegant appearance and new colors to your room. Features: Perfect Match These elegant functional curtains can be hung individually to let beautiful light through your windows, or can be mixed with blackout curtains to create a more decent and unique room decoration for any of your windows. Use Occasion This curtain is a decorative short drapery that can give your windows a new look. It is very suitable for covering kitchens, bathrooms, laundry rooms, studios, etc. The window curtains have pole pockets and are easy to hang. Easy to Clean Machine wash or hand wash in cold water, save you more time and energy, gentle cycle, hang to dry after washing, dry in low temperature and warm iron as needed, in order to extend the service life of curtains, do not bleach. REDY MADE: Each measures 39'' wide x 80'' long, 1 panel per package. Constructed with rod pocket, easy to install and slide.
QUALITY MATERIAL: With faux linen look, the cream sheer curtains are made of premium textured polyester fabric, durable and long-lasting, filmy and breathable, safe and environmental friendly, allowing the natural light let in gently while providing your privacy,
ELEGANT DESIGN: The sheer white curtains without any pattern decoration are simple and elegant, fresh and natural, which can match well with any color floor and furniture,add some peaceful and romantic atmosphere into your room
WIDE APPLICATION: These off white faux linen sheer curtains are breathable but not transparent, create a sense of nature and comfort in your living room, bedroom, dining room,kids room, nursery room, patio,balcony, doorway, etc, any indoor or outdoor places.
EASY CARE: Machine washable in cold water, tumble dry low and no bleaching

The Nicole Miller Turion linen look window curtain panels feel luxurious and rich to the hand.   The elegant jacquard branch pattern provides a sophisticated, modern fashion look to your decor.   The woven blackout design provides insulation, light control, and privacy. These panels will drape beautifully from your favorite curtain rod by 8 matte silver, 1-5/8" diameter grommets per panel. Nicole Miller provides a design vision that is unparalleled and offers a modern aesthetic, with plays on sophistication, prints, and fabrics. Use the Turion window curtain panels as the perfect finishing touch for any living room, dining room, bedroom, bathroom, and home office. The result is a blend of uptown and downtown styles that offer timeless designs and eclectic, modern sensibility.

Transform any room in your home with these luxurious textured jacquard window treatments. The Majestic textured jacquard window panels add an elegant flair to any living space. Extra wide 54 in. panel offer styling versatility and maximum window coverage. Easy slide, open and close decorative metal grommets allow you to block sunlight and create instant privacy in one easy movement. From traditional to contemporary spaces, these textured jacquard drapes are sure to compliment any decor. Each grommet panel measures extra wide 54 in. x 84 in. long and fits up to a 1.5 in. curtain rod. Curtain rod sold separately. Curtains are available in an array of fashion colors. Easy care, machine washable polyester. Do not bleach, cool iron if needed. Imported.

Package Includes: Sold as 2 panels, measures 42” wide X 63” long each. Total 84” x 63”.
Grommet Top Design: RUTTERLLOW grommet blackout curtains have 6 shiny grommets, 1.6” inner diameter each, fit standard size curtains rod, look great when you hung on coordinating metal rod.
Functions: RUTTERLLOW blackout curtains can block out 80-95% sunlight due to different colors (Dark color works better than light color). As a barrier, our blackout curtains’ quality is heavy enough to insulate your home against outside thermal energy in summer. On the contrary, keeps outside cold away from your warm house. Also, our curtains can reduce the noise from outside to provide you a better environment to work or sleep.
More Choices: These heavy quality blackout curtains are available for multiple options in colors & sizes. Coordinate with our RUTTERLLOW linen sheer curtains in our store to provide you a delicate home décor experience.
Easy Care: Machine washable (in cold water) for easy care and maintenance. Do not bleach, tumble dry low and warm iron as needed.

Transform any room in your home with these luxurious Window Elements Florabotanica printed faux silk window treatments. Florabotanica curtain panels are specially woven to create a textured surface that looks and feels like raw silk. A slight sheen adds style and decorative flair to each window panel. Easy slide, open and close decorative metal grommets allow you to filter sunlight and create a great atmosphere in one easy movement. These beautifully printed faux silk panels are sure to compliment any decor. Grommet panel measures extra wide 54 in. with your choice of 84 in. or extra-long 90 in. and fit up to a 1.5 in. curtain rod. Curtain rod sold separately. Coordinating curtains are available in an array of fashionable patterns. Easy care, machine washable cotton blend. Do not bleach, cool iron if needed. Imported.
